relationships.subject: Gilaburu extract
relationships.evidence_quote: Elevated macroscopic and microscopic damage scores, high tissue wet weight values, increased tissue-associated MPO, MDA, CL, caspase-3, 8-OHdG, cytokines (TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, IL-8), MMP-9, TGF-β<sub>1</sub>, smad-3 levels, and decreased GSH values of the AA group were all reversed by GB treatments

key_findings: Gilaburu reversed oxidative and inflammatory markers in acetic acid colitis in rats.
